title: Accessible navigation is incorrect for trellised bar charts

complexity.rationale: No existing precedent for faceted keyboard navigation: needs a new nested-facet structure graph, per-facet focus-ring geometry, and per-facet popover/inspect anchoring, each requiring its own design decision rather than repeating an existing pattern.

summary: Enabling accessibleNavigation on a trellised Bar produces incorrect keyboard navigation — panels are merged, node ids collide, group labels/counts are wrong, and the focus ring/popover anchor to the wrong position — because the data-navigator structure and focus geometry have no notion of the trellis facet.
symptom: With accessibleNavigation on a Bar that has a `trellis` prop, keyboard navigation treats every trellis panel as one chart: bars from different panels that share a dimension value are merged into a single navigable group, stack counts and aria labels are wrong, and the focus ring / popover land on the wrong bar because positions are read from the shared band scale instead of the facet's repeated scale.
rootCause: The navigator is only ever told about dimension/color/metric/orientation. In RscChart.tsx the <Navigator> dispatch forwards those fields but never the Bar's `trellis`/`trellisOrientation`. NavMarkFields (navigableMarks.ts) now includes a `trellis` field (added to gate dual-metric-axis labeling), but it is not threaded through the nav chain (Navigator -> dataNavigatorAdapter -> buildChartStructure -> buildBarStructure). As a result buildBarStructure groups all rows by dimension alone via groupIntoStacks: rows from different facet panels collapse into one Stack, and segmentId(dimensionValue, colorValue) repeats across panels, so segment node ids collide and stack aria labels (buildNodeLabel) report merged counts/totals. Separately, focus geometry (focusedItemGeometry.ts, getBarScaledPoint) reads the top-level 'xBand'/'yBand' and metric scales via view.scale(); in a trellis plot the per-panel dimension/metric scale is a repeated scale inside the trellis group mark (getRepeatedScale / getTrellisGroupMark in barSpecBuilder.ts and trellisedBarUtils.ts), not the top-level scale, so the focus ring and popover anchor resolve to the wrong facet position.

comparison.aspect: Grouping of bars into navigable units
comparison.expected: Each trellis panel is its own group of stacks/bars; a dimension value in panel A is distinct from the same dimension value in panel B.
comparison.actual: All panels are flattened; rows sharing a dimension value are merged into a single Stack regardless of which panel they belong to.

comparison.expected: Every navigable bar/segment has a unique id, namespaced by its facet.
comparison.actual: segmentId(dimension, color) collides across panels, so different bars share the same node id.

comparison.expected: The focus ring and popover anchor to the focused bar inside its own panel, using that panel's repeated scale.
comparison.actual: Positions are read from the top-level xBand/yBand scale, so they resolve to the wrong (or a nonexistent) location for faceted data.

crossCutting.notes: touchesTooltipOrPopover: the keyboard-focus popover/inspect anchor comes from getFocusedItemBounds/getFocusedItemClientPosition (focusedItemGeometry.ts), which must resolve per-facet positions for a trellis bar, so fixing navigation also affects where the focused-item popover/tooltip appears. requiresS1S2Parity: false — accessibleNavigation/dataNavigator exists only in the s2 packages (no vega-spec-builder / react-spectrum-charts equivalent), so there is no s1 sibling to mirror.

implementationPlan.change: Bug location (input surface): NavMarkFields has `trellis` (added for dual-axis gating) but no `trellisOrientation`. Add `trellisOrientation` so the mark's faceting is fully available to the navigator.
Bug location (the <Navigator> dispatch): forward the Bar's trellis/trellisOrientation (and the trellis field's display title) to <Navigator> alongside dimension/color/metric/orientation.

Bug location (groupIntoStacks/segmentId/buildBarStructure): teach the structure builder about facets — nest each trellis panel as its own dimension level (root -> panel -> stack/group -> segment) so grouping, node ids, and aria labels are per-panel rather than merged. groupIntoStacks and segmentId need a facet key to keep ids unique.
Threading: carry the new trellis/trellisOrientation options from the adapter into buildBarStructure, mirroring how dimension/color/metric flow today.
Threading: add trellis/trellisOrientation to AttachDataNavigatorOptions and pass them to buildChartStructure.
Threading: add trellis/trellisOrientation to NavigatorProps and forward to attachDataNavigator (including the effect dep array).

Bug location (getBarScaledPoint): reads the top-level xBand/yBand + metric scales; for a trellis bar it must resolve the panel's repeated scale and the panel's group offset instead. Reference the repeated-scale construction in trellisedBarUtils.ts / barSpecBuilder.ts (getRepeatedScale, getTrellisGroupMark).

Reference: source of truth for how facets and their repeated scales are laid out; the geometry/structure fixes must match this layout. May also need to expose or name per-facet scales so the focus geometry can look them up.
Reference/verification: add coverage for a trellised data set asserting per-panel grouping, unique node ids, and correct per-panel counts once the fix lands.

openQuestions: What is the desired keyboard model for facets — should Escape from a panel's first group step out to a panel level and then to the chart root, and should arrow keys wrap within a panel or cross into the adjacent panel?

Can the per-facet dimension/metric scales be resolved through the public Vega View API (view.scale within the facet's group context), or does the spec builder need to emit uniquely-named per-panel scales for the geometry helper to read?
